items.overview: A action-drama movie about if the gunpowder plot succeeded
items.title: Plan Fawks

items.overview: Vostrov, a talented sound engineer who despises the cynicism of the entertainment industry, agrees to fabricate audio evidence of infidelity for a jealous client. He has no idea that his professional lie will trigger an act of domestic violence.
items.title: Sound Pressure

items.overview: A little boy visits his grandparents, but the grandmother is missing and the grandfather is acting weird.
items.title: Chaos Is The True Nature of Things

items.original_title: Photomaton, la grande histoire de la petite photo
items.title: Photomaton, la grande histoire de la petite photo

items.overview: After this, there's no turning back
items.title: Connor (Muppet Movie 2.0)

items.original_title: Darius Rucker: They Called Me Hootie
items.overview: Darius Rucker gets deeply personal about the cost of stardom, revealing his struggles with drugs and alcohol, the breakdown of his marriage and brushes with death. Through candid interviews with collaborators, friends and family, new footage from the road and in the studio as he records his forthcoming album and never-before-seen tape dating back to the start of Hootie & the Blowfish, this documentary traces the full journey of his extraordinary career, revealing a deeply personal story of ambition, resilience and reinvention.
items.title: Darius Rucker: They Called Me Hootie

items.overview: At 83, Louise Forestier is a freer, more engaged, and more vibrant artist than ever. Structured in nine chapters, like the nine songs on her latest album, this "docu-musical" unfolds as an ode to nature and the passage of time.
items.title: Old Crow

items.overview: A young man helps his friend overcome his insecurities about cricket by sharing his own unfulfilled childhood dream, reminding him that we don't have to be good at something to enjoy doing it. A heartwarming story about friendship, childhood passion, and never losing the inner child.
items.title: Mazhalai

items.original_title: Piccola anatomia di corpi al lavoro
items.overview: The four directors build the narrative around these repetitive movements: moving objects, operating machinery, digging holes and laying foundations. The workers' bodies follow a precisely timed routine, leading the viewer to question what an artistic gesture is. This routine is interrupted by the metamorphosis of the images, as the workers' silhouettes detach themselves from reality to become two-dimensional projections on a screen. The conventional meaning usually given to manual labor is subverted, taking on an entirely new significance.
items.title: Piccola anatomia di corpi al lavoro

items.original_title: Canti della specie - Un viaggio con Antonio Moresco
items.overview: What if the end is simply a moment of transition? In Canti della specie, we hear the voice and thoughts of the writer Antonio Moresco on human extinction through five deliberately conflicting conversations.
items.title: Canti della specie - Un viaggio con Antonio Moresco

items.overview: On 3 February 2018, Luca Traini opens fire in the streets of Macerata, wounding six people. Two of them, Kofi Wilson and Omar Fadera, had reached Italy after a dangerous journey from Ghana and Gambia, risking their lives in the desert and in Libya. They believed they were finally safe in Macerata: “Maybe I’m in Heaven,” Kofi says. But they were not.
items.title: Heaven

items.original_title: The Noah Movie; Epilogue: The Last Don
items.overview: 4 years after the events of “The Noah Movie: The Complete Epic”,  Noah Feliz is operating quietly in New York City.  Things go wrong quickly once again when he almost gets killed at a friendly dinner hosted by fellow don, Salvatore Giorgio. See how it all ends in this fantastic conclusion to an amazing crime saga.
items.title: The Noah Movie; Epilogue: The Last Don

items.overview: A poetic and political investigation into eroticism as a vital force. The documentary essay delves into the tension between control and desire to explore what remains of the erotic in a society shaped by guilt and colonial logic. Uniting philosophy, psychoanalysis, and art through deep interviews and visceral performances, the film challenges moral constraints and invites us to recognize the body as the first territory to be counter-colonized.
items.title: erōtikós

items.original_title: The Neighbourhood is Changing: Revisiting Mulberry Street
items.overview: In 2005, a group of up-and-coming filmmakers based in Lower Manhattan set out to make an independent horror film called Mulberry Street, in which a virus turns ordinary New Yorkers into rat people. 20 years later, they reflect on the making of the film and what it has to say about the evolution of New York City.
items.title: The Neighbourhood is Changing: Revisiting Mulberry Street

items.overview: A hypnotic journey through the archive of María Tupper (1893–1965), a Chilean artist and spiritualist who tirelessly compiled and organized her photographs, drawings, paintings, diaries, letters, and 8mm films.
items.title: Los Fantasmas de María

items.overview: June stays endlessly busy and tethered to her devices to keep her demons at bay. But when she forgets to plug in her phone before falling asleep, she’s forced to face the monster her denial has unleashed.
items.title: The Monster I Made

items.overview: Set on Halloween night, CUTS follows a group of young friends who cross paths with a mysterious figure wearing a cracked clown mask. What they mistake for an elaborate Halloween prank quickly descends into a brutal fight for survival.
items.title: Cuts

items.original_title: 在你心之所向的地方 电影版
items.overview: Childhood friends Ling Zi Ming and Cheng Yi, along with bickering duo Lu Xiang Lin and Yue Yu Zhi, have grown up side by side. The four boys share the happiest days of their youth together, but along the way, subtle changes begin to emerge in their feelings for one another. They once believed they would never have to say goodbye, yet as they grow older, their paths gradually lead them in different directions...
items.title: In Your Heart Movie Version

items.overview: A lonely house on a farm is haunted by a scarecrow, but what lives inside the house is far more dangerous.
items.title: Hollow Ones

items.overview: As a burdened teen girl’s hallucinations intensify, she confides in her devout mother, unaware of a buried truth resurfacing to fracture the reality within their home.
items.title: The Fraying

items.overview: Eclipse of the moon. The shadow of the earth gets projected onto the moon's surface. The Super-8 camera tries to catch it. A playful imprint on the emulsion, brought back to light by hand in the darkroom.
items.title: Schattenfangen

items.overview: Immersive and poetic film in which a dancer from Honduras leaves the city to return to the Afro-Caribbean Garifuna community of his youth, searching for his past, cultural identity, healing rituals, and a sense of connection.
items.title: Where the Sun is Born

items.overview: This deep dive into Romania's chaotic 2025 elections echoes global patterns of democratic erosion and the growth of fascist movements—with social media fueling the frenzy.
items.title: Small Expectations

items.overview: Cyprus, July 1974. President Makarios has been ousted in a coup, and a Turkish invasion is imminent. A pilot recounts the very last flight to Nicosia Airport: should he land or not?
items.title: No Man's Air

items.overview: An essay film exploring the gap between the propaganda and reality of Soviet labor camps. Composed entirely of archival footage that often evokes a reality all its own, it juxtaposes conflicting accounts from figures including Gorky and Solzhenitsyn.
items.title: My Own Personal Gulag

items.overview: After his childhood friend Vaguinho commits suicide, Rodolpho decides to devote a novel to his rebellious friend. Vaguinho was a leading figure in the punk movement of the farming community where they grew up, amid plantations drenched in pesticides.
items.title: Morro Grande

items.overview: On 14 March 1978, 17-year-old Rico Carpaye was killed by far-right militants on the island of Réunion. Those responsible went unpunished. Nearly 50 years later, this desktop documentary unravels the story behind the silence surrounding the crime.
items.title: A Minute of Silence

items.overview: Serene Husni, a Palestinian filmmaker living in the diaspora, returns to her parents' hometown in the occupied West Bank. Conversations with residents reveal the continuing impact of the Nakba, the mass displacement of Palestinians in 1948.
items.title: Jenin & the Nakba Between Us

items.overview: Laboring in a Cuban ship graveyard, an almost apocalyptic world of fire and creaking sheets of steel, Pitufo dreams of a better life. An atmospheric, magical glimpse into a life on society's margins.
items.title: Bahía Honda

items.overview: For years, exiled Syrian artist Assem Al-Bacha has been working on a giant sculpture of the 11th-century poet Al-Maari, intended to raise awareness of his country. Will the sculpture ever make it home?
items.title: Alter Ego

items.overview: Across football stadiums, concert halls, and religious gatherings, three Egyptians live in the shadow of famous figures they strikingly resemble. A journey into how a genetic coincidence evolved into a profession, an identity, and a destiny - and how the lookalike came to fill a space the real celebrity never could, meeting admirers in streets, villages, and local celebrations, becoming a star within reach and, at times, rivaling the original.
items.title: The Lookalike

items.overview: The film follows the months after December 1, 2024, when Edoardo Bove suddenly collapses on the pitch during Fiorentina’s match against Inter. The incident disrupts what seemed to be a clear path for one of Italian football’s brightest young talents and marks the beginning of an entirely new chapter in his life. From that moment on, Edoardo faces a suddenly uncertain future: will he play again? Will he still be able to do so in Italy? And who is Edoardo beyond football?
items.title: In un battito

items.overview: Yang, a nurse with an unusually selective sense of smell, can tolerate only disinfectant and lemon—until she encounters the scent of Fang, a man in a vegetative state. As she imagines her way into his memories, guilt and forbidden desires, the boundaries between intimacy, projection and death begin to dissolve. Moving between waking life and dream, Aroma is a dark contemporary fairy tale about the body, desire, and love that refuses to disappear when the body does.
items.title: Aroma

items.overview: Documentary on the making and legacy of Mulberry Street featuring new interviews with cast and crew
items.title: The Neighbourhood is Changing

items.overview: At the end of the 70s, Eduardo Kabral continues with his TV show presenting all the members of his crew.
items.title: ¿Quién hace la...? - 1979

items.overview: On the night of her 21st birthday, a sexually frustrated virgin tries to convince her celibate boyfriend to have sex with her.
items.title: Trifecta

items.overview: Stripped of color and clothes, ready to be cleansed. A young man's midnight bath becomes a surreal nightmare the moment he realizes he is not alone.
items.title: Midnight Knocks at the Door

items.overview: An ageing Elvis impersonator finally faces up to his demons as he travels through the Irish midlands with his long-lost brother, who has recently quit his life in a monastery.
items.title: One Sweet Hour

items.overview: A young sex worker, Maria, sets out to reconnect with her estranged biological father, but their growing relationship takes an unexpected turn as she conceals her true identity, forcing her to confront the delicate line between deception and healing.
items.title: Oblivion

items.overview: "Girl and Wolf" is an animated feature film for a young adult public based on the Roc Espinet's homonymous graphic novel. It tells the story of Paula, an innocent girl who lives in a medieval village attacked by wolves. Paula will have to face dark childhood traumas, soulless hunters, magical wild spirits and an ancient pack of wolves.
items.title: Girl and Wolf

items.overview: Iliya the Knight of Murom, son of a peasant, was born disabled and was unable to walk until he turned 33. He then was miraculously healed and became a great warrior during his faithful service to Kniaz Vladimir Monomakh by fighting against invaders and helping Kniaz consolide Russianlands.
items.title: Iliya Muromets

items.overview: An ode to the culture of northern Bali, where the gods are thanked through offerings to the past and the future. The rice cycle, with its ancient traditions, paints a timeless portrait of life.
items.title: the offerings

items.overview: A tick infestation drives a group of campers out of their tent as their only light source slowly loses power. Their conflicting instincts pit them against one another.
items.title: The Lantern

items.overview: Destination X (2026) is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on November 15, 2026 at Edmonton Expo Centre, Canada.
items.title: TNA Destination X 2026

items.overview: In a home where fights erupt and everything is quietly reset by morning, two young sisters begin secretly plotting their parents’ divorce, believing it’s the only way to save their family.
items.title: The Children Trap

items.overview: Ira reluctantly takes the bus to meet up with a guy from online, but when her date cancels mid-ride, she decides to join the middle-aged bus driver on his smoke break.
items.title: Route 16

items.original_title: Food and Shelter (Hey Hey Bye Bye)
items.overview: docu-melodrama in which a woman remembers their childhood and escapes from hell.
items.title: Food and Shelter (Hey Hey Bye Bye)

items.overview: Two old highschool acquaintances reconnect by coincidence after running into each other at a bar. Hijinks Ensue.
items.title: Off-Key

items.overview: A young street satay vendor burdened by financial struggles and a failing satay business , struggling with the arrival of his estranged younger brother, faces the harsh realities of urban poverty.
items.title: Alleyway

items.overview: A story about identity, heartbreak, and music– about the selves we lose, the ones we become, and the ones still waiting for us. Somewhere between a memory and a dream.
items.title: Lu

items.overview: On the island of Gran Canaria, an old tradition has faded into legend: el pámpano roto, a ritual that brought local young people together in a phallic dance whose original meaning has been lost to history. Fearful that recollections of this tradition may fade from memory, three journalists set out to find the last surviving people to witness the dance in person.
items.title: Pámpano roto

items.overview: An alcoholic and drug-addicted father takes his children Joaquín and Valentina to see an Oasis concert in Castilla y León after seeing a surreal advertisement on television.
items.title: The Oasis Concert

items.overview: During the summer of 1955, the beautiful and rebellious Isabella leaves her husband and takes their daughter Alissa  to her mother's house in Jerusalem.  There she meets Richard, an English business man on a trip and falls in love with him against her mother's wishes while using Alissa as an alibi.  Alissa, torn between her mother and grandmother, begins to discover old painful secrets in her family are preventing her mother from ever being truly happy.  As the truth slowly comes to light, it threatens to destroy everything they've built and known...
items.title: Isabella- Beer Sheva

items.overview: A satire of the well-known, "The Notebook" (2004).
items.title: The Notebook: reimagined

items.overview: Prom night is just around the corner at Roarville Academy, and 17-year-old Sidney Rivers isn't exactly thrilled about going. But with his enthusiastic best friend Harvey Brooks determined to make it a night to remember, and a new girl in town catching Sidney's attention, things might just get interesting!
items.title: Sidney Rivers: Rebel Heart

items.overview: A 45-year-old corporate worker befriends a group of young skaters and secretly begins learning to skateboard during his lunch breaks. When doubt and judgment creep in, he must decide whether to abandon the joy he’s found or embrace the risk of starting over.
items.title: Don’t Bail

items.overview: Q, a 21-year-old filmmaker caught between ambition and self-doubt, isolates himself to finish a short film he hopes will change his life. But when his college roommate Alonso throws a party, the night spirals into tension, confrontation, and a moment of reckoning that forces Q to face what’s really holding him back. Only 21 is a grounded, emotional portrait of creative pressure, growing up, and finding the courage to take the first real step toward your dreams.
items.title: Only 21

items.overview: A horror stop-motion animation film exploring queer desire and emancipation after the death of Michelle's abusive and homophobic mother.
items.title: Cabbageworm

items.overview: Together since high school, Alexandre and Jordan travel to the United States to fulfill their dream of becoming fathers through surrogacy, which is illegal in France. Their meeting with Nicole, who agrees to carry their child, ushers in a period of hope and anticipation, as well as doubts and trust to be built. Through appointments, decisions to be made, and the upheavals of daily life, each of them gradually finds their place in this journey that binds them together forever.
items.title: Papas

items.overview: They've shared blood, money, and years of friendship. They know each other's habits, their weaknesses, their tells.  But someone at the table has been playing a different game all along...
items.title: RaTaTaTurn

items.overview: A young woman, coming to terms with the loss of her boyfriend, receives a letter in the post with a USB containing videos of him.
items.title: The Memory of You

items.overview: For generations, a family has had a human skull in their home. They journey through historical, ethical, spiritual and scientific perspectives to try to understand who this individual was and how to properly care for their remains.
items.title: Jolly

items.overview: 12 Scenes. 20 Characters.
items.title: Domestics

items.original_title: NON È LA FINE DEL MONDO
items.title: NON È LA FINE DEL MONDO

items.overview: Nine voices from different generations trace the history of wingsuit flying, from the invention of the suit to the preparation for a jump and the desire to fly.
items.title: Birdlife

items.overview: An American expat’s first-day commute on Berlin’s Ringbahn becomes a loop that will not stop. Its enforcers demand a fare; his ticket and credentials mean nothing. The machine wants the one thing he refuses to give.
items.title: Ringatory

items.overview: In a remote village, a determined teenage boy named Asho makes a brave decision and takes a two-year-old girl named Asma to another village so her arrival may bring blessing. On the way, an unexpected event forces Asho to choose between returning Asma and following his own need.
items.title: Wolf's Hair

items.overview: A documentary set in Gatineau, Québec, following a group of teenage friends who gather for an underground fight club in a garage. Through an evening of boxing matches, the film explores the dynamics of friendship, rivalry and camaraderie among the group.
items.title: No Cheap Shots

items.overview: The Anti-Friend is a film about friendship, money and art.
items.title: KIRAC 32: The Anti-Friend

items.overview: Herbert, a middle-aged investment banker, secretly spends his lunch breaks learning to skateboard after a group of local skaters take him in. However, when a coworker finds out, he must decide what scares him more: judgment or regret.
items.title: Don’t Bail

items.overview: Join Dan and many other friendly faces from across Austin, TX, as they perform multiple pain-inducing stunts and gags  to commemorate Dan's 26th birthday including; The Uni-Bastard, The Blind Butt Tattoo, and Baby Oil Couch Surfing.
items.title: danass

items.overview: An ordinary night turns into a living nightmare when a 14-year-old boy hears a sharp tap on his bedroom window.  Outside in the freezing air stands a breathless stranger, desperately running from the police. With sirens wailing in the distance, a terrifying standoff begins through the glass. Safe inside but completely isolated, the boy faces an impossible, split-second choice that will instantly shatter the security of his home.
items.title: Who Are You?

items.overview: When an unexpected event shatters a 10-year-old girl’s mental state, her hyper-precise daily ritual of cooking sour soup for her sick mother completely breaks down, leaving her with a ruined recipe she can no longer fix.
items.title: Sinigang na Tuyo (Dried Pork Stew)

items.overview: A young Deaf artist struggling to connect with her mother finds an unexpected bridge through friendship, art, and Filipino Sign Language, forcing her to confront their widening distance.
items.title: Patlang (Gap)

items.overview: Max, a blind Zapotec accordion player, and Sam, a British violinist who speaks "poquito" Spanish, meet on the streets of Oaxaca City. There a friendship is born that transcends language, culture, music, and the senses.
items.title: Zapocelta

items.original_title: Antisémitisme, une haine toujours en mouvements
items.title: Antisémitisme, une haine toujours en mouvements

items.overview: The film bears a joint Egyptian-German character, and through its title and artistic journey, it provides a space to celebrate one of the most prominent figures of Arab music, composer Mohamed Abdel Wahab, and to explore his musical legacy and influence, with the participation of Fatma Said, who is considered one of the most prominent Egyptian voices in the world of opera and classical singing globally blending cinematic and musical language.
items.title: Fatma Said and the Abdelwahab Plan

items.overview: A theatre critic interviews the first AI to have an original play open on Broadway.
items.title: _Preview_

items.overview: A short film produced by the 2nd Unit Class at SZFE.
items.title: Exit

items.overview: Inspired by real events where the heroic act of pedestrians saved a man from his cousin, who attacked him with a knife attack due to an argument about inheritance.
items.title: Unspoken Worlds

items.overview: Augusta Street, São Paulo, near future. Amid neon and underpaid gigs claimed by robots and cyborgs, a lonely android wanders in search of a pleasure it may never have been programmed to feel.
items.title: Augusta 2049: A Street Named Sin

items.overview: A lonely British-Chinese girl is excited to finally make a new friend when her new neighbours move in, but soon comes to realise that the world is never so simple…
items.title: Chilli Chong Carne

A journey into how a genetic coincidence evolved into a profession, an identity, and a destiny - and how the lookalike came to fill a space the real celebrity never could, meeting admirers in streets, villages, and local celebrations, becoming a star within reach and, at times, rivaling the original.
results.title: The Lookalike

results.overview: The film follows the months after December 1, 2024, when Edoardo Bove suddenly collapses on the pitch during Fiorentina’s match against Inter. The incident disrupts what seemed to be a clear path for one of Italian football’s brightest young talents and marks the beginning of an entirely new chapter in his life. From that moment on, Edoardo faces a suddenly uncertain future: will he play again? Will he still be able to do so in Italy? And who is Edoardo beyond football?
results.title: In un battito

results.overview: Yang, a nurse with an unusually selective sense of smell, can tolerate only disinfectant and lemon—until she encounters the scent of Fang, a man in a vegetative state. As she imagines her way into his memories, guilt and forbidden desires, the boundaries between intimacy, projection and death begin to dissolve. Moving between waking life and dream, Aroma is a dark contemporary fairy tale about the body, desire, and love that refuses to disappear when the body does.
results.title: Aroma

results.overview: Documentary on the making and legacy of Mulberry Street featuring new interviews with cast and crew

results.overview: During the summer of 1955, the beautiful and rebellious Isabella leaves her husband and takes their daughter Alissa  to her mother's house in Jerusalem.  There she meets Richard, an English business man on a trip and falls in love with him against her mother's wishes while using Alissa as an alibi.  Alissa, torn between her mother and grandmother, begins to discover old painful secrets in her family are preventing her mother from ever being truly happy.  As the truth slowly comes to light, it threatens to destroy everything they've built and known...

Only 21 is a grounded, emotional portrait of creative pressure, growing up, and finding the courage to take the first real step toward your dreams.

Through appointments, decisions to be made, and the upheavals of daily life, each of them gradually finds their place in this journey that binds them together forever.
